---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or a change to existing behavior.
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What you'd like to do

Describe the feature or behavior you'd like to see.

## Why current behavior doesn't support it

What's the limitation today? What workflow gap or pain point led you to want this?

## Suggested approach (optional)

If you have a specific idea for how it could work in-game, share it. Otherwise leave blank -- the author will decide on the implementation.

## Additional context

Anything else worth knowing -- examples from other mods, similar features in vanilla FS25, etc.
